updated_for: 2026-09-02 big-data anti-bias, repeatability and situational-race architecture

optimization_targets.trio_policy: Increase trio hit capture only through improvements that preserve or improve the shared horse-selection core across large-sample and unseen validation.

repeatability_learning.rule: A model that wins an initial comparison enters repeated independent validation. One-off winners are not inherited or promoted until reproducibility is demonstrated.

situational_race_shadow.concept: Each race is first classified by its pre-race structure. A pattern-specific strategy is evaluated in parallel with the general model instead of forcing every race into one prediction shape.
situational_race_shadow.integration_gate: A pattern-specific gene can be integrated only after at least 3 independent positive validations (5 recommended), at least 300 races for that pattern, preserved/improved axis and candidate capture, and a final unseen validation pass.
situational_race_shadow.partial_integration_rule: Only the pattern where the strategy repeatedly wins is integrated. Other race patterns remain on the general production core.

shared_selection_core.rule: All wager types share the same horse-selection core: axis durability, candidate pool, partner roles, third-place intrusion and failure scenarios.
shared_selection_core.trio: Primary development surface for 3-horse combination coverage.
shared_selection_core.place: Reads axis 3rd-place durability from the shared core.
shared_selection_core.wide: Reads two-horse simultaneous survival from the shared core.
shared_selection_core.quinella: Adds 1st/2nd-place reach requirements to the shared core.
shared_selection_core.win: Adds win-out requirements to the shared axis core.
shared_selection_core.trifecta: Adds finishing-order reproducibility to the shared three-horse core.
shared_selection_core.coupling_policy: Do not create an isolated trio-only horse ranking. Improvements to horse selection, candidate coverage or intrusion detection must feed every derived wager analysis before wager-specific conditions are applied.
